name: CCSDS 124.0-B-1 POCKET+ Codec
description: Lossless POCKET+ compression and decompression of fixed-length CCSDS housekeeping packets (CCSDS 124.0-B-1). Wraps the tanagraspace/ccsds124 MIT reference C implementation, vendored verbatim and executed unmodified. Pure transform: no host capabilities.

attribution.standard: CCSDS 124.0-B-1 Robust Compression of Fixed-Length Housekeeping Data
attribution.crossValidationCredit: Cross-validation vector suite by Universitat Autonoma de Barcelona (Miguel Hernandez-Cabronero, Ian Blanes, Joan Serra-Sagrista) under technical supervision of Mickael Bruno, CNES

acceptedTypeSets.description: 16-byte POCKET+ parameter header (magic "P+C1", F in bits, robustness, pt/ft/rt periods) followed by a whole number of fixed-length uncompressed packets. Opaque octets: the SDS $CPS record that will carry these parameters is not yet ratified.
Octet-aligned POCKET+ compressed bitstream, byte-identical to the ESA reference encoder.

methods.description: Compresses a run of fixed-length packets as one stateful POCKET+ stream.

acceptedTypeSets.description: 16-byte POCKET+ parameter header (magic "P+D1") followed by the compressed bitstream.
Reconstructed fixed-length packets, bit-exact with the encoder input.

methods.description: Reconstructs the fixed-length packet run from a POCKET+ stream.

acceptedTypeSets.description: A POCKET+ compressed segment, with no parameter header.
8 bytes LE: u32 packet length in bits (0 = not discoverable from this segment), u32 status (0 = exact, 2 = truncated reference packet).

methods.description: Recovers the packet length F from a compressed segment, when the segment contains a reference packet. Used to test whether a segment is self-synchronizing.
